description: This file defines the DecryptedItem class, a specialized implementation of a decrypted data item for a note-taking or data management application. It extends the GenericItem class, implements DecryptedItemInterface, and contains methods for accessing content, references, domain-specific data, and comparison logic. It also manages various boolean states like pinned, archived, protected, etc.

classes.name: DecryptedItem
classes.description: A class representing a decrypted data item, extending GenericItem and implementing DecryptedItemInterface, with additional properties and methods for managing item states and domain-specific data.

methods.name: DefaultAppDomain
methods.description: Returns the default application domain object.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Getter for the content property of the payload.

methods.name: references
methods.description: Returns the list of content references associated with the item.

methods.name: isReferencingItem
methods.description: Checks if this item references another given item.

methods.name: getAppDomainValue
methods.description: Gets a specific value from appData for the default app domain.

methods.name: getAppDomainValueWithDefault
methods.description: Gets a value from appData with a default fallback.

methods.name: payloadRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a copy of the payload, optionally overridden.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies content keys to ignore during equality checks.

methods.name: appDataContentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies appData keys to ignore during equality checks.

methods.name: getContentCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the content.

methods.name: isItemContentEqualWith
methods.description: Checks if this item’s content is equal to another’s, considering ignored keys.
